title: IMDO OSINT — November 13, 2026 — 8:00 AM New York

sections.title: Wars and Armed Conflicts

entries.title: Iran reports LNG tanker mine explosion in Strait of Hormuz
entries.development: Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said an LNG tanker struck a mine and exploded on November 13; vessel identity and casualties were not immediately provided.
entries.significance: Continued attacks in the Strait of Hormuz threaten shipping and energy trade despite expectations of de-escalation.

entries.title: WHO warns respiratory infections are rising in flooded Gaza shelters
entries.development: WHO reported acute respiratory infections 33,000 cases above the comparable prior-year period, amid overcrowding and flooding; diagnostic laboratory supplies remain restricted.
entries.significance: Adds a newly quantified health dimension to previously reported Gaza winter flooding.
entries.uncertainty: WHO surveillance figures; access constraints complicate complete counts.

entries.title: EU envoys agree proposed sanctions listings on Russian finance and shadow fleet
entries.development: EU ambassadors agreed proposed listings of 145 individuals and entities linked to Russia's finance system, shadow fleet and misinformation; ministers are expected to adopt them November 16.
entries.significance: A substantive arms-finance and sanctions development beyond the ongoing ceasefire talks.
entries.uncertainty: Not legally effective until adopted and published.

sections.shortfall: Only three independently sourced developments not already covered in recent reports were selected.

sections.title: Sociopolitical Shifts

entries.title: Spain's Sánchez struggles to mobilize disillusioned left before snap election
entries.development: Reuters reports challenges for the governing left in the run-up to Spain's November 29 snap election, following the nationwide housing strike.
entries.significance: Tests whether housing-driven labor mobilization translates into electoral realignment.

entries.title: NYC lawmakers demand school search without mandatory AI summaries
entries.development: City Council leaders asked Google on November 12 whether schools can retain search access without AI-generated features; response requested by November 19.
entries.significance: Raises governance and student autonomy questions about mandatory AI features in education.
entries.uncertainty: Google's response and actual product options remain unconfirmed.

sections.shortfall: No other distinct, adequately verified new political or labor developments were selected.

sections.title: NYC Affairs

entries.title: Council bill seeks plan for vacant rent-stabilized apartments
entries.development: Council Member Farah Louis introduced a bill directing HPD to study and plan for vacant rent-stabilized apartments; reporting cites roughly 57,000 empty units in 2025.
entries.significance: Relevant to rental supply, preservation and owner incentives, but does not immediately create leasable inventory.
entries.uncertainty: The unit count is a reported estimate; legislation is proposed, not enacted.

entries.title: Council surveillance-pricing proposal awaiting verified outcome
entries.development: Previously scheduled November 12 vote on algorithmic pricing requires outcome confirmation.
entries.significance: Consumer protection and municipal digital governance.

sections.shortfall: Limited independently confirmed new municipal actions; the AI education issue overlaps the sociopolitical section by design.

sections.title: The State of Downtown

entries.title: Poetry Project explores sixty years of little-magazine publishing with Nick Sturm
entries.development: Dis/Course at St. Mark's Church, 131 East 10th Street, on November 13 from 7 to 9 p.m. EST; free with RSVP; examines mimeographed magazines, newsletters and alternative publishing networks.
entries.significance: Direct research opportunity for IMDO magazine and small-press organizing.

entries.title: Poetry Project announces November 20 interdisciplinary performance
entries.development: Crackhead Barney and Ann Liv Young are listed for November 20 at 8 p.m. EST, St. Mark's Church, 131 East 10th Street; general admission $10.
entries.significance: Relevant to experimental downtown performance and potential editorial coverage.

sections.shortfall: The signed-in Instagram session was inaccessible; no independently confirmed new open auditions or submissions were found.

sections.title: Occult Practice & Machine Intuition

entries.title: Abductive logical hypotheses from knowledge graphs
entries.development: Bai and colleagues study generating complex logical hypotheses explaining observations in knowledge graphs, and report improvements using reinforcement learning from graph-derived consistency.
entries.significance: Offers a directly relevant experimental baseline for Pattern Sense and Inference Engine to generate and test explanations.
entries.uncertainty: Older research discovered today; author-reported benchmarks do not establish real-world reliability.

sections.shortfall: Only one distinct research paper with a verified source and sufficient methodological relevance was identified without recycling recent editions. No new verified occult-practitioner or computational-divination announcement.
